verdict.rationale: LM Studio's docs explicitly describe on-demand/JIT model loading where a running server loads a model automatically when a request arrives without restarting the server (lm-studio-docs-29, lm-studio-docs-30), and the CLI supports loading/switching specific models with custom identifiers (lm-studio-docs-13, lm-studio-docs-14) alongside independent server start/stop control (lm-studio-docs-12, lm-studio-docs-22), directly enabling multi-model switching against a live serving endpoint. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of switching between multiple already-loaded models mid-session without any hiccups, and no community citation specifically validates this exact workflow (only tangential requests for a 'pure daemon mode').
